itens.t: Astronauts deploy solar array on 100th US spacewalk by International Space Station crew
itens.r: NASA astronauts successfully completed the historic 100th U.S. spacewalk from the International Space Station to install an upgraded solar array. The milestone underscores ongoing maintenance efforts for the orbiting laboratory.
itens.d:
Two astronauts successfully installed and deployed the second-to-last upgraded solar array for the International Space Station during the 100th U.S. spacewalk from the orbiting outpost. NASA astronaut Anil Menon and Canadian Space Agency astronaut Joshua Kutryk completed the extravehicular activity.

The spacewalk lasted 7 hours and 11 minutes, beginning and ending inside the Quest airlock. Menon carried the rolled-up iROSA assembly using the Canadarm2 robotic arm before securing it on the station's port side with Kutryk.

itens.t: SpaceX fires up Starship upper stage ahead of landmark Flight 15 test launch

itens.d:
SpaceX completed static-fire tests for the Starship upper stage, known as Ship 42, in preparation for its upcoming 15th test flight. The vehicle conducted a full-duration, six-engine static fire along with a single-engine burn to simulate a deorbit maneuver.

The successful tests keep the program on track for a targeted November launch. CEO Elon Musk noted that the company plans to attempt catches for both the Ship and Super Heavy booster using the launch tower arms, pending regulatory approval.

itens.t: Artemis II commander Reid Wiseman named deputy director for NASA's JPL

itens.d:

itens.r: ESA astronaut Luca Parmitano enjoys flying like Superman aboard the International Space Station during Expedition 37. The crew celebrates Halloween in orbit.

itens.t: Saying It With Pictures: North Korea Flashes Its Latest ICBM, SLBMs, and Sub
itens.r: An analysis examining North Korea's display of its latest intercontinental ballistic missiles, older submarine-launched ballistic missiles, and a tactical nuclear attack submarine.

itens.t: North Korea Continues Installing New Fencing
itens.r: Recent observations indicate that North Korea is continuing its efforts to install new border fencing. This security enhancement points to tighter border controls.

itens.t: Border city casts doubt on reports North Korea testing loudspeakers
itens.r: A South Korean border city has expressed skepticism over reports that North Korea tested loudspeakers aimed at the South. Local media had previously cited residents hearing broadcasts.

itens.t: [Robert J. Fouser] Japan in watch-and-wait mode
itens.r: An opinion piece reflecting on a prolonged visit to Japan, offering insights into the country's current socio-political mindset and stance in late 2026. The author discusses local perspectives and regional developments.

itens.t: [WEEKENDER] Iranian physicist turns scientific journey into new life in Korea
itens.r: A profile of an Iranian physicist who transitioned his scientific career to South Korea. It highlights ground-breaking laser research conducted in Gwangju and his new life abroad.

itens.t: [WEEKENDER] Beyond Korea: Foreign entrepreneurs turn Korean culture into business
itens.r: An exploration of how foreign entrepreneurs are leveraging the global popularity of Korean culture—including K-pop, dramas, and beauty products—into successful business ventures.

itens.t: N. Korea reports weapons demonstration featuring cruise missiles, rocket launchers, drones
itens.r: North Korea has announced a recent weapons demonstration showcasing cruise missiles, multiple rocket launchers, and drones. State media reported on the military display.
